describe.description: The creature is depicted in side profile facing to the right, standing upright on two hind legs with its torso raised. It has the head and mane of a large feline at the front top, a spotted feline body and hindquarters in the middle and rear, and two large outstretched feathered wings attached at the shoulder region on either side of the body. The overall coloration is tan and light brown with darker brown spots and feather patterning, and a long spotted tail with a dark tuft curves out from the rear.

describe.description: A large chimeric creature rears upright on two hind legs with its chest held high and a pair of broad feathered wings spread wide. It has the head, rounded ears, full shaggy mane and tuft-tipped tail of a male lion, a neck and upper chest clad in overlapping brown feathers, and a muscular body, hind legs, paws and long tail covered in tawny fur patterned with dark leopard-like rosettes. No forelegs are visible; the wings emerge from the shoulder region where forelegs would be.
